overview.potentialProgressDescription: Potential progress applies the resources you already own after higher-priority goals in your priority order reserve their share. It does not change the goal's actual status.

welcome.title: Welcome to Tacticus Planner
welcome.content: Take a quick tour to discover the key parts of the interface.

search.title: Search pages and actions
search.content: Open search with the button or Ctrl/Cmd+K to jump to any page or run a quick action such as creating a goal, syncing, or sending feedback.

accountDrawer.title: Account and preferences
accountDrawer.content: Manage your theme, language, guided tour, imports, planner name, account, and sign-in options here.

addGoal.title: Add Goal
addGoal.content: Create Character or Machine of War goals, then choose one or more projects. The default project is selected automatically.

sync.title: Sync
sync.content: Refresh your Planner with the latest data from Tacticus.

navigation.title: Find your way around
navigation.content: This menu groups the app's sections, including My Game and Legendary Events — use it to navigate between them at any time.

sidebarFooter.title: Sidebar tools
sidebarFooter.content: Replay this tour any time, and expand or collapse the main navigation rail from here.

bottomNavigationGroup.title: Your main bar
bottomNavigationGroup.content: Switch sections, add a goal, or sync from here. Open Menu to search pages and quick actions, and to reach My Game and Legendary Events.

mobileHeader.title: Page header
mobileHeader.content: Shows where you are. Your account menu — theme, language, and this tour — lives on the right.

accountMenu.title: Account and preferences
accountMenu.content: Open this menu for your theme, language, account settings, imports, feedback, sync status, and sign-in or sign-out.

sectionNavigation.title: Section pages
sectionNavigation.content: This menu lists the pages in the current section. Hide it with the button in its header and bring it back with the button beside the page title; it stays as you left it while you navigate.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.content: Share feedback or ideas with the button next to your account. The public board link stays in the page header.

projectScope.title: Scope by project
projectScope.content: Pick a project to see only its goals — the URL updates so you can bookmark or share the view. This narrows the list you're looking at and changes nothing about your plan or what Dailies calculates.

statusFilter.title: Filter by status
statusFilter.content: Filter goals by Unfulfilled, Reached, Blocked, Active, or Paused.

filters.title: Type and group
filters.content: Narrow by goal type or group related goals together.

select.title: Select goals
select.content: Tick goals to select them. The checkbox in the header selects every goal shown (on mobile, turn on Select first).

bulkActions.title: Bulk actions
bulkActions.content: Pause, resume, add to a project or delete every selected goal at once. Bulk pause and resume act only on the goals you selected.

createGoal.title: Create a goal
createGoal.content: Start a new goal from here — it opens the same creation dialog as the sidebar button.

planningSettings.title: Planning settings
planningSettings.content: Set your daily energy budget here — every estimate on this page uses it.

reprioritize.title: Prioritize your goals
reprioritize.content: Drag a goal to change its priority (on mobile, tap Reorder first). Each drop saves right away and applies in every project that holds the goal.

orderHint.title: How the order works
orderHint.content: Open this hint for how priority works here: one account-wide order, moved by dragging, applying in every project.

list.title: Your goals
list.content: Every goal appears below in your priority order — active and paused goals first, then reached ones. Use a goal's Edit action to change its target, priority, notes, or projects. A unit can have several Rank, Ascension, Ability or Upgrade goals, each labelled with its own target.

seasonFit.title: Season fit
seasonFit.content: Pick a Battle Pass, Guild Raid or Guild War season to see which goals finish in time. A line marks where goals start spilling into the next season.

acquisitionSources.title: Acquisition sources
acquisitionSources.content: Combine campaign farming, Onslaught, and daily shops — select any mix to lower this goal's estimated time.

projects.title: Projects
projects.content: Search for a project name that doesn't exist yet and choose Create to add it here without leaving this form. Which projects hold the goal never changes its status or priority.

mythicMaterialSources.title: Mythic materials
mythicMaterialSources.content: Shop offers for the Mythic materials this goal needs. Every available offer is counted by default; uncheck any you won't buy.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.content: Add milestone to plan several targets for this unit at once, such as Gold 1, then Diamond 1, then Diamond 3. Each becomes its own goal, after the one before it.

status.title: Current status
status.content: Where this unit stands today. Every target starts from here.

issues.title: Problems to fix
issues.content: When something blocks creating the goals, this counts the problems. Choose one to jump to its field.

ladder.title: Target ladder
ladder.content: Pick the target on the ladder. Current marks where the unit is now, and steps marked Already a goal belong to another goal. The line under it shows the range and what it needs.

stepIndicator.title: Three steps
stepIndicator.content: Choose the unit, then its goals, then review and create. Back keeps everything you entered.

list.title: What a project is
list.content: A project is a named selection of your goals — keep several to group different things. The Default project is listed first; a project does not pause or resume anything or change your priorities.

newProject.title: Create a project
newProject.content: Start a new project here. A project's action menu creates a goal in it, manages which goals belong to it, and renames, recolors, archives, or restores it.

target.title: Target
target.content: Pick where this goal ends on the ladder or the level stepper. It keeps its history, and your plan recalculates when you save.

priority.title: Priority
priority.content: Pick this goal's position in your priority order. It moves there when you save, and the goals in between shift by one place.

projects.title: Projects
projects.content: Add this goal to a project, or create a new one from the picker. The new project is saved right away; the goal itself only changes when you save.

mythicMaterialSources.title: Mythic materials
mythicMaterialSources.content: Choose which shop offers supply this goal's Mythic materials. Unchecking every offer stops counting on shops for them.

summary.title: Your collection at a glance
summary.content: How many of the game's characters and Machines of War you own.

faction.title: Grouped by faction
faction.content: Each card holds one faction's characters and Machines of War — the units you own come first.

owned.title: An owned unit
owned.content: The ring shows its rarity, with stars on top, rank and shards on the portrait, and ability levels either side of its XP level below. Select a unit to open its details in the Library.

unowned.title: Not unlocked yet
unowned.content: Greyed-out units aren't in your roster. The bar shows how close you are to unlocking them. Select a unit to open its details in the Library.

toolbar.title: Search, sort and filter
toolbar.content: Find a unit by name, change the order inside each faction, and narrow the list with Filters. Your choices stay in the page address, so you can reload or share them.

quickFilters.title: Quick filters
quickFilters.content: One tap shows the units to work on next: ready to rank up, need to ascend, can ascend, need to level or blue star ready. Select a chip again to clear it.

purpose.title: Campaign event progress
purpose.content: Correct your progress in each campaign event. Daily raids use these values to decide which event nodes you can farm.

current.title: Current event
current.content: The event running right now is pinned here, already expanded. It's the only event daily raids plan for.

editor.title: Edit a track
editor.content: Step the regular-battle count, drag the bar, or use Max. Toggle challenges one by one. "Reset to synced" undoes a manual value.

summary.title: Event summaries
summary.content: Each event shows its progress at a glance and whether values are manual or have no synced data. Open it to edit.

hideCompleted.title: Hide completed events
hideCompleted.content: Unfinished events are listed first. Turn this on to hide completed ones; the choice is remembered in this browser.

save.title: Save your changes
save.content: Once you edit something, a bar with Save and Discard appears at the bottom. You'll be asked before leaving with unsaved changes.

alliances.title: Alliance progress
alliances.content: Set the sector and tier each alliance is farming. Each card shows the shards one run pays at that position.

save.title: Save your changes
save.content: Once you edit something, a bar with Save and Discard appears at the bottom. You'll be asked before leaving with unsaved changes.

card.title: Install the app
card.body: Add Tacticus Planner to your home screen. It opens in its own window, and a long-press on its icon jumps straight to Daily raids, Goals or Legendary events.
card.installedBody: Open it from your home screen or app list. Long-press its icon (right-click on desktop) for shortcuts to Daily raids, Goals and Legendary events.

dialog.title: Install Tacticus Planner
dialog.description: Open the planner like an app, in its own window, from your home screen, dock or Start menu.
dialog.maybeInstalled: No install option in the menu? The app is probably installed already: open it from your home screen or app list.
dialog.unsupported: This browser can't install web apps. Open the planner in Chrome, Edge or Safari to install it.

ios.share: Tap Share in Safari's toolbar (in Chrome or Edge, Share is in the address bar).
ios.add: Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.

macSafari.addToDock: In Safari's menu bar, choose File, then Add to Dock.

android.install: Tap Install app or Add to Home screen.

desktop.menu: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar, or open the browser menu (⋮ or …).
desktop.install: Choose Install Tacticus Planner (in Edge: Apps, then Install this site as an app).

shortcuts.heading: Shortcuts
shortcuts.body: Once installed, long-press the app icon (right-click it on desktop) to jump straight to:

tacticusUserId.invalid: Enter your Tacticus user ID as a GUID, for example 3f2504e0-4f89-11d3-9a0c-0305e82c3301.
tacticusUserId.inUse: This Tacticus user ID is already linked to another planner account.
